lines.text: How fast are you moving now? Sitting perfectly still.
lines.phonemes: hˌaʊ fˈæst ɑːɹ juː mˈuːvɪŋ nˈaʊ? sˈɪɾɪŋ pˈɜːfɛktli stˈɪl.

lines.text: Earth spins: at the equator, the ground moves about sixteen hundred seventy kilometers an hour. That beats the speed of sound.
lines.phonemes: ˈɜːθ spˈɪnz: æt ðɪ ɪkwˈeɪɾɚ, ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd mˈuːvz ɐbˌaʊt sˈɪkstiːn hˈʌndɹɪd sˈɛvənti kɪlˈɑːmɪɾɚz ɐn ˈaʊɚ. ðæt bˈiːts ðə spˈiːd ʌv sˈaʊnd.

lines.text: And Earth circles the Sun at about thirty kilometers every second. Since this began, you've gone farther than New York to Boston.
lines.phonemes: ænd ˈɜːθ sˈɜːkəlz ðə sˈʌn æɾ ɐbˌaʊt θˈɜːɾi kɪlˈɑːmɪɾɚz ˈɛvɹi sˈɛkənd. sˈɪns ðɪs bɪɡˈæn, juːv ɡɔn fˈɑːɹðɚ ðɐn nˈuː jˈɔːɹk tə bˈɔstən.

lines.text: Ptolemy argued that if Earth moved, birds and clouds would be left behind. In sixteen thirty-two, Galileo answered with a ship's cabin. Below deck on calm water, nothing tells you the ship is moving. You feel a jolt, never a smooth ride.
lines.phonemes: tˈɑːləmi ˈɑːɹɡjuːd ðæt ɪf ˈɜːθ mˈuːvd, bˈɜːdz ænd klˈaʊdz wʊd biː lˈɛft bᵻhˈaɪnd. ɪn sˈɪkstiːn θˈɜːɾitˈuː, ɡˌæləlˈeɪoʊ ˈænsɚd wɪð ɐ ʃˈɪps kˈæbɪn. bᵻlˌoʊ dˈɛk ˌɔn kˈɑːm wˈɔːɾɚ, nˈʌθɪŋ tˈɛlz juː ðə ʃˈɪp ɪz mˈuːvɪŋ. juː fˈiːl ɐ dʒˈoʊlt, nˈɛvɚɹ ɐ smˈuːð ɹˈaɪd.

lines.text: Zoom out. The Sun drags us round the galaxy at about two hundred thirty kilometers a second. One lap: about two hundred thirty million years. Last time round, the first dinosaurs had just appeared.
lines.phonemes: zˈuːm ˈaʊt. ðə sˈʌn dɹˈæɡz ˌʌs ɹˈaʊnd ðə ɡˈælɐksi æɾ ɐbˌaʊt tˈuː hˈʌndɹɪd θˈɜːɾi kɪlˈɑːmɪɾɚz ɐ sˈɛkənd. wˈʌn lˈæp: ɐbˌaʊt tˈuː hˈʌndɹɪd θˈɜːɾi mˈɪliən jˈɪɹz. lˈæst tˈaɪm ɹˈaʊnd, ðə fˈɜːst dˈaɪnəsˌɔːɹz hæd dʒˈʌst ɐpˈɪɹd.

lines.text: So your speed has no single answer. First ask: compared to what?
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ jʊɹ spˈiːd hɐz nˈoʊ sˈɪŋɡəl ˈænsɚ. fˈɜːst ˈæsk: kəmpˈɛɹd tə wˈʌt?

lines.text: Light time, across your galactic trip so far: about a twentieth of a second. To the galaxy's center: about twenty-seven thousand years.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪt tˈaɪm, əkɹˌɑːs jʊɹ ɡɐlˈæktɪk tɹˈɪp sˈoʊ fˌɑːɹ: ɐbˌaʊt ɐ twˈɛntiəθ əvə sˈɛkənd. tə ðə ɡˈælɐksiz sˈɛntɚ: ɐbˌaʊt twˈɛntisˈɛvən θˈaʊzənd jˈɪɹz.

lines.text: Next: more trees on Earth, or stars in our galaxy?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: mˈɔːɹ tɹˈiːz ˌɔn ˈɜːθ, ɔːɹ stˈɑːɹz ɪn ˌaʊɚ ɡˈælɐksi?
